attribution.note: Marcus explicitly endorses the comparison between the studies.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves his substantive comparison and treats the named paper as a title.

contract.note: Broad corroboration is an ordinary reading of 'reinforces'; direct replication is unnecessary. Excluding the evaluative aside about appreciation from the empirical verdict is fair.

evidence.note: The pre-post study reports that benchmark accuracy can overstate visual understanding, supporting the substantive comparison.
The named Nguyen-coauthored paper documents simple visual failures alongside strong benchmark performance. Its publication history establishes earlier work.
The earlier Nguyen-coauthored study documents visual answers distorted by prior knowledge and text, supporting a related series of findings. The supplied version predates the post.

reviews.rationale: The studies substantively converge on limitations in visual grounding despite apparent competence. Their different tasks and failure mechanisms do not defeat broad corroboration. The earlier papers establish a research record beginning in 2024; whether they were underappreciated remains an evaluative judgment outside the empirical verdict.

attribution.note: The AGI assessment is Marcus's own assertion following the quoted study.

semantics.note: The quip asserts a present classification of the models discussed; its rhetorical style does not remove that substantive assertion.

contract.note: Broad human-level competence is a fair ordinary reading of AGI. Restricting the assessment to the studied models and rejecting flawless-performance requirements preserves the statement's scope.

evidence.note: The dated framework supplies relevant definitional context but does not assess the studied model versions or establish their AGI status.

reviews.rationale: The packet supplies no evaluation establishing or refuting broad human-level competence for the studied versions. Definitional context cannot settle their status, and visual failures alone lack the required connection to a necessary capability deficit. Neither outcome is established under the fair plain-reading contract.
